'''Ice trolls''' are monsters that are found in [[Troll tunnels]] and [[Ice Path]].

Players can obtain a soul of a troll for the [[Slayer Codex]] from this creature when carrying an [[ushabti]].

During the quest [[Desert Treasure]], when the player is trying to get the [[ice diamond]] from [[Kamil]]. Five or six ice trolls have to be killed to gain access to the ice cave on the eastern side.
